<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.9/dist/web/static/pretendard.min.css">
<style>
.ppm3{--pt:#FF5A3C;--pt-d:#e0431f;--ink:#17181c;--ink2:#4a4d55;--mut:#868a93;--line:#edeef1;--soft:#f6f7f9;--cream:#FFF4EF;--dark:#16171b;
 font-family:"Pretendard",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.65;background:#fff;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}
.ppm3 *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;}
.ppm3 svg{display:block;} .ppm3 img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
.ppm3 a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit;}
.ppm3 .wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;}
.ppm3 .kick{display:inline-block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--pt);background:var(--cream);padding:7px 15px;border-radius:999px;}
.ppm3 h1{font-size:clamp(31px,5vw,54px);line-height:1.16;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.035em;}
.ppm3 h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.3vw,36px);line-height:1.25;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;}
.ppm3 h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;}
.ppm3 p{color:var(--ink2);}
.ppm3 .lead{font-size:clamp(16px,1.7vw,19px);color:var(--ink2);}
.ppm3 .mut{color:var(--mut);}
.ppm3 .sec{padding:80px 0;}
.ppm3 .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:15.5px;border-radius:14px;padding:15px 26px;transition:.16s;cursor:pointer;border:1.5px solid transparent;}
.ppm3 .btn svg{width:17px;height:17px;}
.ppm3 .btn-pt{background:var(--pt);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 22px -10px rgba(255,90,60,.8);}
.ppm3 .btn-pt:hover{background:var(--pt-d);transform:translateY(-1px);}
.ppm3 .btn-out{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-color:#e2e3e7;}
.ppm3 .btn-out:hover{border-color:#c7c9cf;}
.ppm3 .head{max-width:730px;margin:0 auto 44px;text-align:center;}
.ppm3 .head .kick{margin-bottom:15px;} .ppm3 .head p{margin-top:13px;}
.ppm3 .crumb{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.ppm3 .crumb .in{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.ppm3 .crumb a{color:var(--mut);} .ppm3 .crumb a:hover{color:var(--pt);}
.ppm3 .crumb .sep{opacity:.5;} .ppm3 .crumb .cur{color:var(--ink);}

.ppm3 .hero{background:radial-gradient(78% 62% at 50% -8%,var(--cream),#fff 70%);padding:60px 0 0;text-align:center;}
.ppm3 .hero .kick{margin-bottom:20px;}
.ppm3 .hero p.sub{max-width:660px;margin:20px auto 0;font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.7vw,18.5px);color:var(--ink2);}
.ppm3 .hero .cta{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin:30px 0 10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.ppm3 .heroviz{max-width:900px;margin:44px auto 0;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 34px 70px -34px rgba(20,22,28,.34);}
.ppm3 .heroviz img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;}
.ppm3 .strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:42px;}
.ppm3 .strip .s{background:var(--soft);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 16px;text-align:center;}
.ppm3 .strip .s .v{font-size:16.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
.ppm3 .strip .s .l{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:4px;}

.ppm3 .cores{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;}
.ppm3 .cores.c4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}
.ppm3 .core{padding:28px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;}
.ppm3 .core .en{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--pt);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.ppm3 .core h3{font-size:16.5px;margin:9px 0 8px;}
.ppm3 .core p{font-size:14.5px;}

.ppm3 .conts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:22px;}
.ppm3 .cont{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;transition:.16s;}
.ppm3 .cont:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 22px 44px -24px rgba(20,22,28,.24);border-color:transparent;}
.ppm3 .cont .cscene{aspect-ratio:16/9;background:radial-gradient(125% 120% at 50% 0%,#222732,#0b0d12 82%);overflow:hidden;}
.ppm3 .cont .cscene svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;}
.ppm3 .cont .cscene.cemoji{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.ppm3 .cont .cscene.cemoji span{font-size:74px;}
.ppm3 .ytbox{position:relative;width:100%;padding-top:56.25%;background:#000;overflow:hidden;}
.ppm3 .ytbox .ytposter{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.ppm3 .ytbox iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;z-index:2;}
.ppm3 .ytbox .ytplay{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:3;opacity:0;transition:.16s;pointer-events:none;}
.ppm3 .ytbox .ytplay svg{width:23px;height:23px;fill:#fff;margin-left:3px;}
.ppm3 .ytbox.islink{cursor:pointer;}
.ppm3 .ytbox.islink .ytplay{opacity:1;}
.ppm3 .ytbox.islink:hover .ytplay{background:var(--pt);}
.ppm3 .cont .cbody{padding:22px 24px 24px;}
.ppm3 .cont .cmore{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-top:14px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--pt);}
.ppm3 .cont .cmore span{transition:transform .16s;}
.ppm3 .cont:hover .cmore span{transform:translateX(3px);}
.ppm3 .cont h3{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.ppm3 .cont p{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.6;}
.ppm3 .cflip{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:cflip 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ppm3 .cslidex{transform-box:fill-box;animation:cslidex 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ppm3 .cpulse{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:cpulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ppm3 .croll{animation:croll 1.3s linear infinite;}
.ppm3 .cbar{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:bottom;animation:cbar .9s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes cflip{0%,100%{transform:scaleX(1);}50%{transform:scaleX(.06);}}
@keyframes cslidex{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-9px);}50%{transform:translateX(11px);}}
@keyframes cpulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(.9);opacity:.6;}50%{transform:scale(1.06);opacity:1;}}
@keyframes croll{to{stroke-dashoffset:-48;}}
@keyframes cbar{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.3);}50%{transform:scaleY(1);}}
.ppm3 .scat{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:cscatter 3s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ppm3 .cfall{transform-box:fill-box;animation:cfall 2.4s ease-in infinite;}
@keyframes cscatter{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(.4);opacity:.25;}25%{opacity:1;}55%{transform:translate(var(--tx,0),var(--ty,0)) scale(1);opacity:1;}80%{opacity:1;}}
@keyframes cfall{0%{transform:translateY(-26px);opacity:0;}18%{opacity:1;}80%{opacity:1;}100%{transform:translateY(74px);opacity:0;}}

.ppm3 .hw{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:44px;align-items:center;}
.ppm3 .specgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px;}
.ppm3 .srow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:15px 20px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:13px;align-items:center;}
.ppm3 .srow .k{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--mut);flex:0 0 auto;}
.ppm3 .srow .v{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-align:right;}
.ppm3 .srow .v small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;margin-top:2px;}

.ppm3 .cases{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;}
.ppm3 .cases.c1{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,460px);justify-content:center;}
.ppm3 .cases.c2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;}
.ppm3 .case{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;transition:.16s;}
.ppm3 .case:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px -22px rgba(20,22,28,.25);border-color:transparent;}
.ppm3 .case .th{aspect-ratio:16/10;background:#e9ebef;overflow:hidden;}
.ppm3 .case .th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.ppm3 .case .cb{padding:15px 17px 17px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;}
.ppm3 .case .cb .cl{display:block;margin-top:9px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--pt);}

.ppm3 .xgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;}
.ppm3 .xcard{display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:center;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:#fff;transition:.16s;}
.ppm3 .xcard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px -22px rgba(20,22,28,.25);border-color:transparent;}
.ppm3 .xcard .em{font-size:24px;flex:0 0 auto;width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--cream);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.ppm3 .xcard .xt h3{font-size:15px;} .ppm3 .xcard .xt p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px;}
.ppm3 .backrow{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:30px;}
.ppm3 .backrow a{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--pt);}

.ppm3 .cta-band{background:radial-gradient(80% 120% at 50% -20%,var(--cream),#fff);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;padding:70px 40px;text-align:center;}
.ppm3 .cta-band .cta{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin-top:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;}

/* HUB */
.ppm3 .modelgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;}
.ppm3 .mcard{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;transition:.16s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.ppm3 .mcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 24px 44px -26px rgba(20,22,28,.3);border-color:transparent;}
.ppm3 .mcard .mv{aspect-ratio:16/10;}
.ppm3 .mcard .mb{padding:18px 20px 20px;}
.ppm3 .mcard .mt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
.ppm3 .mcard .mt .em{font-size:20px;} .ppm3 .mcard .mt b{font-size:16.5px;font-weight:800;}
.ppm3 .mcard .md{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.55;}
.ppm3 .mcard .go{font-size:13px;color:var(--pt);font-weight:700;margin-top:12px;display:inline-flex;gap:5px;}
.ppm3 .picker{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px;}
.ppm3 .pick{padding:26px 28px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;}
.ppm3 .pick .q{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:12px;}
.ppm3 .pick .opt{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
.ppm3 .pick a{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:#42454c;background:var(--soft);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;transition:.14s;}
.ppm3 .pick a:hover{background:var(--cream);color:var(--pt);}

/* ===== DEVICE STAGE ===== */
.ppm3 .dev{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:radial-gradient(125% 110% at 50% 0%,#222732,#0b0d12 82%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;}
.ppm3 .dev svg{width:82%;height:82%;}
.ppm3 .dev .label{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:16px;text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em;}
.ppm3 .spin{transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box;animation:ifspin 16s linear infinite;}
.ppm3 .rip{transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box;animation:ifrip 2.6s ease-out infinite;}
.ppm3 .rip2{transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box;animation:ifrip 2.6s ease-out infinite;animation-delay:1.3s;}
.ppm3 .bob{transform-box:fill-box;animation:ifbob 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ppm3 .petal{transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box;animation:ifpetal 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ppm3 .beam{transform-origin:left center;transform-box:fill-box;animation:ifbeam 4s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ppm3 .blink{animation:ifblink 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ppm3 .sweepbar{animation:ifsweep 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ppm3 .arc{stroke-dasharray:6 8;animation:ifdash 3s linear infinite;}
@keyframes ifspin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}
@keyframes ifrip{0%{transform:scale(.25);opacity:.9;}100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:0;}}
@keyframes ifbob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);}50%{transform:translateY(-6px);}}
@keyframes ifpetal{0%{transform:scale(.2) rotate(0);opacity:0;}30%{opacity:1;}100%{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(40deg);opacity:0;}}
@keyframes ifbeam{0%,100%{opacity:.28;}50%{opacity:.6;}}
@keyframes ifblink{0%,100%{opacity:.35;}50%{opacity:1;}}
@keyframes ifsweep{0%{transform:translateX(-120%);}100%{transform:translateX(120%);}}
@keyframes ifdash{to{stroke-dashoffset:-56;}}

@media(max-width:880px){
 .ppm3 .strip,.ppm3 .cores,.ppm3 .cores.c4,.ppm3 .conts,.ppm3 .xgrid,.ppm3 .modelgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
 .ppm3 .hw{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px;}
 .ppm3 .cases,.ppm3 .cases.c2,.ppm3 .picker{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}
@media(max-width:520px){ .ppm3 .strip,.ppm3 .cores,.ppm3 .cores.c4,.ppm3 .conts,.ppm3 .xgrid,.ppm3 .modelgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .ppm3 .spin,.ppm3 .rip,.ppm3 .rip2,.ppm3 .bob,.ppm3 .petal,.ppm3 .beam,.ppm3 .blink,.ppm3 .sweepbar,.ppm3 .arc,.ppm3 .cflip,.ppm3 .cslidex,.ppm3 .cpulse,.ppm3 .croll,.ppm3 .cbar,.ppm3 .scat,.ppm3 .cfall{animation:none!important;}
}
</style>

<section class="hero"><div class="wrap"><span class="kick">IF SERIES · 투명 인터랙티브 캔버스</span><h1>투명한 캔버스 위에<br>손끝으로 남기는 것들</h1><p class="sub">이프-C는 방명록 전용 장비가 아닙니다. 투명한 유리 위에 손끝이 닿는 순간 그 자리가 캔버스가 되고, 그 위에 서명·드로잉·AI 퀴즈·안내·설문이 얹힙니다. 무엇을 남길지는 행사와 공간이 정합니다.</p>
<div class="cta"><a class="btn btn-pt" href="https://29d88.channel.io/workflows/95856">렌탈·구매 문의 <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a><a class="btn btn-out" href="https://smore.im/form/n13gfnjr0b">견적 문의</a></div>
<div class="heroviz"><img src="https://source.inblog.dev/featured_image/2026-05-18T06:10:33.272Z-1fba9ee7-40e6-4aba-a28d-c0647182ba4a" alt="이프C 적용 현장" loading="lazy"></div><div class="strip"><div class="s"><div class="v">40″</div><div class="l">투명 터치 캔버스</div></div><div class="s"><div class="v">올인원</div><div class="l">전원 하나로 설치</div></div><div class="s"><div class="v">정전식 터치</div><div class="l">부드러운 필기감</div></div><div class="s"><div class="v">멀티 콘텐츠</div><div class="l">방명록·드로잉·퀴즈</div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="sec"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><span class="kick">핵심 가치</span><h2>왜 이프C인가</h2></div><div class="cores"><div class="core"><div class="en">Transparent Canvas</div><h3>공간을 가리지 않는 캔버스</h3><p>인테리어를 해치지 않는 투명한 개방감. 화면 너머 공간이 그대로 비쳐, 허공에 그리는 듯한 장면이 만들어집니다.</p></div><div class="core"><div class="en">Beyond Guestbook</div><h3>방명록에서 끝나지 않습니다</h3><p>같은 캔버스 위에서 서명이 퍼포먼스가 되고, 낙서가 AI 일러스트가 되고, 그림이 퀴즈가 됩니다. 소프트웨어만 바꾸면 성격이 달라집니다.</p></div><div class="core"><div class="en">All-in-One Kiosk</div><h3>전원 하나로 설치 완료</h3><p>빔프로젝터·PC·터치 센서가 내장된 일체형 키오스크로, 전원 연결 하나면 설치가 끝납니다.</p></div></div></div></section>
<section class="sec" style="padding-top:0;"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><span class="kick">대표 콘텐츠</span><h2>이런 콘텐츠를 올립니다</h2></div><div class="conts"><div class="cont"><div class="cscene"><img src="https://source.inblog.dev/post_image/2026-03-31T05:09:23.130Z-73ab8c6e-3dae-446e-ac5a-60c85d7074e2" alt="디지털 방명록 & 서명 퍼포먼스" loading="lazy" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;"></div><div class="cbody"><h3>디지털 방명록 & 서명 퍼포먼스</h3><p>캔버스에 남긴 서명이 실시간으로 대기 화면·대형 스크린에 송출됩니다. 말풍선·Floor·Floar·5×3 그리드·트랙 등 퍼포먼스를 골라 연출합니다.</p><a class="cmore" href="/if/content/digital-guestbook">자세히 보기 <span>&rarr;</span></a></div></div><div class="cont"><div class="cscene"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Paint-Q: AI 드로잉 퀴즈" loading="lazy" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;"></div><div class="cbody"><h3>Paint-Q: AI 드로잉 퀴즈</h3><p>그리면 AI가 알아봅니다. 커스텀 문제 출제부터 AI 프롬프트 드로잉·매직 스케치까지, 드로잉을 축으로 확장되는 콘텐츠 묶음입니다.</p><a class="cmore" href="/if/content/paint-q">자세히 보기 <span>&rarr;</span></a></div></div><div class="cont"><div class="cscene"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="통합 방명록 시스템" loading="lazy" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;"></div><div class="cbody"><h3>통합 방명록 시스템</h3><p>디지털 방명록·공간 안내도·Paint-Q·설문 4가지 기능을 한 키오스크에서 쓰는 올인원 소프트웨어.</p><a class="cmore" href="/if/content/unified-guestbook">자세히 보기 <span>&rarr;</span></a></div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="sec" style="padding-top:0;"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><span class="kick">하드웨어</span><h2>제품 사양</h2></div><div class="hw"><div class="heroviz" style="box-shadow:none;"><div class="dev"><svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="ifcg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#8fe3ff" stop-opacity=".30"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8fe3ff" stop-opacity=".07"/></linearGradient></defs><rect x="94" y="20" width="132" height="88" rx="5" fill="url(#ifcg)" stroke="rgba(196,238,255,.55)" stroke-width="1.4"/><path class="blink" d="M116 82 q14 -28 26 -7 q10 17 22 -13 q9 -21 21 5" fill="none" stroke="#FF5A3C" stroke-width="2.8" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="cpulse" cx="197" cy="65" r="4.5" fill="#FF5A3C"/><rect x="150" y="108" width="20" height="32" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.10)"/><rect x="110" y="140" width="100" height="11" rx="4" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.15)"/></svg><div class="label">IF-C · 40″ 투명 리어 터치 · 1100×500×1200</div></div></div><div class="specgrid"><div class="srow"><span class="k">모델명</span><span class="v">IF-C (Transparent Guestbook)</span></div><div class="srow"><span class="k">디스플레이</span><span class="v">40인치 투명 리어 스크린 (Rear Projection Film)<small>고투명·고화질 필름</small></span></div><div class="srow"><span class="k">프로젝터</span><span class="v">내장형 초단초점 프로젝터<small>선명한 시인성</small></span></div><div class="srow"><span class="k">터치 센서</span><span class="v">정전식 터치 (Capacitive Touch)<small>부드러운 필기감</small></span></div><div class="srow"><span class="k">본체 크기</span><span class="v">1100 × 500 × 1200 mm<small>필기가 편한 디자인</small></span></div><div class="srow"><span class="k">외부 연결</span><span class="v">USB · LAN · Power (220V)</span></div><div class="srow"><span class="k">운영 체제</span><span class="v">Windows 10/11 IoT Enterprise</span></div></div></div></div></section>

<script>
(function(){
 var soft = location.protocol==='file:' || (window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
 function on(box){
  var vid=box.getAttribute('data-yt'); if(!vid||box.dataset.on)return; box.dataset.on='1';
  if(soft){ box.classList.add('islink'); box.addEventListener('click',function(){window.open('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v='+vid,'_blank','noopener');}); return; }
  var f=document.createElement('iframe');
  f.src='https://www.youtube.com/embed/'+vid+'?autoplay=1&mute=1&loop=1&playlist='+vid+'&controls=0&modestbranding=1&rel=0&playsinline=1&disablekb=1&fs=0&iv_load_policy=3';
  f.setAttribute('allow','autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture'); f.setAttribute('frameborder','0'); f.setAttribute('title','제품 영상'); f.setAttribute('referrerpolicy','strict-origin-when-cross-origin'); f.loading='lazy';
  box.appendChild(f);
 }
 var boxes=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.ytbox[data-yt]'));
 if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
  var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){on(e.target);io.unobserve(e.target);}});},{rootMargin:'250px'});
  boxes.forEach(function(b){io.observe(b);});
 } else { boxes.forEach(on); }
})();
</script>
